attrs.evidence: (⇐) is FED-Q1-STAR. (⇒) is a construction, and it runs: given two satisfiable instances meeting at one variable with disjoint projections there, make each its own site. They meet at a cut vertex, so no cycle is split; both sites are satisfiable; the union is not. The check finds such a pair for {OR, NAND} at |D|=2 and verifies all four properties of the resulting federation.
attrs.prior_art: As FED-Q1-STAR. Labelled proved-here; not attributed to BFMY.
attrs.statement: Split-cycle sufficiency holds for EVERY Γ-federation if and only if Γ has 1-point amalgamation.
